what: 8-step machine state byte: b0=ext-ver-digits, b3-6=which-seq armed, b7=active
note: doc 44 F7; b0 read by SOFTWARE VERSION frame builder sub_9CF4

what: b3 = KEY LOCK flag (also the key-seq gate). default 0x11 (b0,b4). toggled by sub_1CF0A bnot #3
note: b3 is user KEY LOCK; b0 default-set = MEMORY WRITE NEXT (F335); b2=MEMORY PROTECT

what: 0-based menu group index; 1-based group = index+1. Arms on 0, 5, 8, 10
note: H13 map: index 0 = group 1 DISPLAY (0x1515C), 5 = group 6 (0x151A0), 8 = group 9 APRS (0x151BE), 10 = group 11 OPTION (0x151DE)

what: dword must equal 0x66600 or the 0-based index 8 and 10 arms return
note: no abs16 writer; immediate 0x66600 only at those two cmps. 0x66600 is code ac3b (cmp.b #0x3B), not a screen object. Index 0 and 5 do not read it

what: byte set to 0x16 by the index-8/10 arms and by the b3/b4 completions
note: readers 0x2D5BA, 0x2E1AC, 0x33F3E beq to rts when the byte is 0x16 (skip the following screen restore). They do not select a key table. Key-table base follows the screen id at 0x10EDA and 0x29AAE

what: RADIO ID edit-enable flag; completion done_b3 and code 04030708 set it =1
note: RADIO ID CHECK page screen 0x8D keys 4/5/6/D gate char edit/save on it

what: persisted feature-flag byte default 5; sub_1645E=bnot b3, sub_16456=bnot b4
note: b3 read 0x14B08 (enable group 13); b4 read 0x2998C/0x14EF2/0x7C62 (RAM DISPLAY). doc 32/23

what: LEVEL backing byte, default 0x19; saturating range 0x13..0x21 (15 values)
site(s): read 0x534C; dial 0x166AA jsr sub_3F600 then 0x69A6 (rts); exit 0x192C4 saves R1 n=0x89; init 0xE58C
note: screen 0x41: dial slot 0x12334, exit word 0x19B04. Record at 0x166BA is 13 21 00 ff 89 a9. H13 has the screen model

what: screen 0x5C backing byte; record {lo 0, hi 3} at 0x16B5A is 4 values 0..3, not 3-state
site(s): read 0x56EA (sub_56E6 sends F31A); dial 0x16B4E jsr 0x3F628 (wrap); exit 0x19312 saves R1 n=0x96
note: dial slot 0x123A0, exit word 0x19B3A. SUB slot for code 0x1A is rtsd (doc 44 / H13)

what: MAIN row-code -> per-item sender stub table; slot 0x7930 (code 0x41)=sub_534C, 0x799C (code 0x5C)=sub_56E6
note: callers index by @(1,er0) = the current row code

what: 15 per-group row-code sub-tables; neither 0x41 nor 0x5C appears
note: so codes 0x41/0x5C are never produced by the normal menu walker (doc 32)

what: keypad return columns (active-low); sub_100E4 decodes @0x4C to internal codes
normalised current internal key code consumed by the 8-step machine (@(1,er0) on edit screens derives from it)
site(s): many; final in sub_FA30 at 0xFBD8; FFA9F0=last-key
note: the key compared at each step is the screen's current key code
